mechanism: Betamethasone (corticosteroid) may reduce the efficacy of topical minoxidil for hair growth and can potentiate systemic minoxidil's vasodilatory effects when used systemically, with additive hypotensive effects.
action: If using minoxidil topically on skin treated with betamethasone, separate application sites or allow betamethasone to be absorbed first; monitor blood pressure if minoxidil is used systemically with betamethasone.
